newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT-Nasdaq rally stands out for its broad base.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Nasdaq rally stands out for its broad base.

text.p: Nasdaq stocks on Thursday took a breather from their record-breaking sprint, but broad support for the recent advance has left the market less vulnerable than after past moves up, technical analysts said.

Previous rallies in the Nasdaq market were dominated by heavyweights Intel Corp and Microsoft Corp. While those two stocks have been among the leaders of the recent surge, they have had many followers.
Among Nasdaq stocks, there were about 600 more advancing issues than decliners on Tuesday; there were 400 net advancers on Wednesday.
